title: 25--Vehicular Equipment Components
description_text: It is anticipated that the U.S. Government will award a contract for Vehicle Spare Parts for NAVFAC EURAFSWA at NSA Naples and NAS Sigonella. The Contractor shall provide different types of Cover Wheels, Valves, Rim Wheels, Tires and Belts. Request for Quote (RFQ) number N6817118Q0041, will be available in electronic format and will be posted to the European Navy Electronic Commerce on Line (EURONECO) site located at https://www.euro.neco.navy.mil. Place and time of delivery will be specified in the solicitation.
